title: ML Serving Module Profile v1
summary: A module that packages, evaluates, serves, or integrates machine learning models through batch or live inference.

integration_points.name: model_package
integration_points.description: Model files, runtime assumptions, provenance, and status.

integration_points.name: inference_api
integration_points.description: Input, output, runtime, limits, and error semantics.

integration_points.name: model_quality
integration_points.description: Evaluation metrics, datasets, scope, and known limitations.

checks: Model artifact declares files, runtime, provenance, and source data.
Inference input and output schemas are explicit.
Evaluation report declares metrics, datasets, scope, and status.
Deployment health and rollback behavior are discoverable.
Model limitations or unsafe uses are documented.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for model-serving modules and model-consuming services.
Keep model IO, runtime, and evaluation surfaces explicit.
Report model artifact, inference surface, evaluation, and deployment health.
